correct_reading.explanation_field: inherited from the replay/splice harness text; WRONG for this record: this IS a real-vs-generated ROC on held-out sessions, with the stated limits (one forger checkpoint, six real vs six forged per evaluation seed, three evaluation seeds sharing splits)
